name: Hockenheimring
layout_source: https://racing.porsche.com/events/pccd-08-hockenheimring-2026 (Porsche Carrera Cup Deutschland 2026 season finale on the DTM weekend: 17-turn current GP layout)

select.only_ways_note: Pinned to the ways of the verified lap so the drawing regenerates identically.

verify.notes: Official reference: the circuit's own GP outline (SVG, white on transparent) rasterised with PyMuPDF to hockenheim.png (track dark on white). It is a stylised outline, hence the slightly higher 1.5% score. Excluded from the OSM graph: rallycross ways (446193574-77), the drag strip 'Rico Anthes Quartermile' (1416119746) and the pit lane 'Boxengasse' (15446020). include_ways 117570502 'Spitzkehre' (the hairpin): build_loop.is_pitlike() drops it because its name contains 'pit' (toolkit bug).

notes: Lap = closed loop of the raceway ways closest to the official length. The PCCD 2026 graphic of Hockenheim states 'Length 4,754 m' (apparently a digit swap of 4,574) and is drawn schematically, so it was not used as the reference.
